related: enzyme II of the phosphotransferase system

definition: Catalysis of the PEP-dependent, phosphoryl transfer-driven transport of substances across a membrane. The transport happens by catalysis of the reaction: protein N-phosphohistidine + sugar(out) = protein histidine + sugar phosphate(in). This differs from primary and secondary active transport in that the solute is modified during transport.
label: protein-N(PI)-phosphohistidine-sugar phosphotransferase activity
